reviews.summary: The top results are long lists of interchangeable compliments; this gives 100 reasons written as small real moments to copy tonight, then answers how to write your own, how many and how to give them.

Every product claim and link checks out. Spanish needed four fixes: the cold-feet line reversed its meaning, 'cuándo' should be 'cuando', 'lo mío' read translated, and the jar note spoke to the sender instead of the recipient and said 'teléfono' for 'móvil'.
Every page-one result is a long list of generic qualities; this gives 100 reasons as specific moments, then the method and a generic-versus-yours table, how many to write and how to give them.

applied: ES: 'Me pones los pies helados encima', 'Lo dices cuando algo es injusto', 'lo que estoy escribiendo', jar note 'Basta con agitar el móvil o tocar el frasco: …'.

Polish taken: 'las mayores tonterías', 'con miedo y todo', 'para coger la idea'; EN 'have never had to ask twice'; jar note says each reason is a short note of a line or two (the schema caps a reason at 160 characters); older post's link reads 'list of 100 reasons why I love you'.
rejected: Polish not taken: a different last reason, paper-jar sizes, a time estimate takeaway, a gender line in the FAQ, '52' in a heading, and 'galletas' for 'picoteo' (each adds or changes text without fixing anything).

reviews.summary: Unlike the top results, which are bare lists of interchangeable compliments, this gives 100 specific borrowable moments plus a method, a before-and-after table and ways to give them, so the reader can write their own twenty tonight.

All four Spanish fixes are in and correct; it is the only page for this search that pairs 100 reasons written as specific moments with a method for writing your own, in Spanish that reads as written in Spain.

It is the only page-one result whose 100 reasons are written as real, specific moments, and it also teaches how to write and hand over your own, with a before/after table, target numbers and ways to give them.

rejected: Final-round polish recorded, not applied (RUBRIC step 4): '2am' in one reason, a for-him-or-her heading, 'jar, letter, one a day' in a heading, 'cada una en una nota corta', and 'agotada' for 'sin fuerzas'.
